intensified comparative adjective; fused form kept as one token

items.question: Is any reality higher or more exalted than the guru?
premises: Nothing is more exalted than the guru.
The beloved is directly addressed with this claim.
items.inference: Therefore, the guru stands as the supreme and unsurpassed reality.
uncertainties: The referent of ataḥ may point back to the guru or to the preceding context.
items.plain_english: O beloved, there is nothing higher or more exalted than the guru.
